subject.title: Telegram detached subagents can run silently without liveness or terminal notification

question: Should detached-subagent liveness be implemented as Telegram-only UX, as generic task/session activity consumed by Telegram, or deferred behind the broader session-activity work?
rationale: The terminal-delivery bug has a narrow candidate fix, but heartbeat cadence, suppression rules, and whether this belongs in Telegram or generic session activity require maintainer product/API direction before automation can safely implement it.

options.title: Generic activity source plus Telegram rendering
options.body: Review #97963 for the terminal handoff and design a metadata-only task/session liveness source that Telegram can render with channel-specific typing or status messages.

options.title: Telegram-only liveness policy
options.body: Implement a narrower Telegram progress/terminal path now, accepting possible duplication with later generic session activity work.

options.title: Defer to broad session activity
options.body: Keep this issue blocked on the broader gateway/session activity work and accept that Telegram detached subagents remain silent until that ships.

recommendation.title: Generic activity source plus Telegram rendering
recommendation.body: Review #97963 for the terminal handoff and design a metadata-only task/session liveness source that Telegram can render with channel-specific typing or status messages.

likelyOwner.reason: The inspected current-main implementation for task delivery, subagent announcement delivery, and Telegram typing routes through code currently carried by this owner in history.
